svg.title: Infrastructure automation in three published figures
svg.desc: Three published figures: IBM NS1 Connect runs on 26+ points of presence across six continents; HashiCorp says Nomad users manage 10,000+ nodes with minimal SRE support; IBM offers NS1 Connect free for 30 days, with 50M DNS queries a month and 500 DNS records. The first and third figures are IBM's, from its NS1 Connect page and pricing page; the second is HashiCorp's, an IBM company. Neither states test conditions for them.
